title: Essais, self-édition, Volume III (Livre II ch. 36+ and Livre III)
author: Michel de Montaigne
edition: Général Michaud's 'self-édition' (Firmin-Didot, Paris, 1907), based on 1595 posthumous Marie de Gournay edition. Preserves period orthography. Original text section only.
notes: Livre II ch. 36+ (labeled 'LIVRE SECOND. (ORIGINAL)') and Livre III (labeled 'LIVRE TROISIÈME. (ORIGINAL)'). Vol III's Michaud translations start at line 13858 (labeled 'LIVRE SECOND. (TRADUCTION)') and are excluded. Livre III was added in the 1588 edition — hence the date.
